en: The front of the postcard is a black-and-white photograph showing a well-maintained park with a large bandstand or concert shell on the right and a formal balustrade in the foreground. In the background are tall leafy trees, colonnaded structures, and a classical-looking building. The text at the bottom reads 'Bad Pyrmont' and 'Konzertplatz mit neuem Konzerthaus,' indicating a concert square with a new concert building. The back of the postcard contains pre-printed address lines, stamps, and handwritten addresses, as well as markings from a museum in Bad Pyrmont.
